//: The run's memory budget (docs/design/performance.md, "Bytes per person"), read by orchestrator/test/memory-budget.test.ts (slow tier): a town of `town` run `days` days on the release kernel, all code, with `threads` engine threads, must peak at no more resident memory than overhead_bytes + bytes_per_person for each person it starts with. The target is target_bytes_per_person (Naz, 2026-10-25: about 50 KB a person, so 50,000 people in some 2.5 GB and 100,000 in 5 GB, beside the fixed overhead); bytes_per_person is the ceiling held now, lowered as each cut lands, to the target. Lowering it goes with the cut that earns it; raising it is a decision, with its entry in docs/decisions.md.
